cards.title: Online booking
intro: By marking, select from the list of classes you want to show in the menu on your website as available for online booking.

fields.label: Allow online booking
fields.help: Displays/hides the programme from the booking form. Thus, whether the programme will be (dis)enabled on your website for online booking.

fields.label: Priority
fields.help: Defines the programme’s display order for clients. By default, programmes are sorted alphabetically, but a higher priority (0–1000) moves the programme higher in the list. The default priority is 0.

fields.label: Display in catalogue
fields.help: By marking, classes will be displayed in the menu on your website

fields.label: Allow multiple bookings for the programme
fields.help: Suitable for parents with twins. Normally, booking for twins needs to be done one by one. With this setup, a parent can enrol their children at the same time.

fields.label: Minimum number of bookings
fields.help: What is the minimum number of people that can enrol per form?

fields.label: Maximum number of bookings
fields.help: What is the maximum number of people that can enrol per form?

fields.label: Collect basic data from:
options: All bookings — Each booking provides its own name, email, and phone independently.
Only the first booking — Only the first booking (the person submitting the form) provides name, email, and phone. The remaining bookings inherit these basic details.

fields.label: Collect additional data (additional fields) from:
fields.help: This setting controls which bookings must submit the mandatory additional fields. It does not control whether the buyer or the attendee fills the field — the booking form handles that automatically.
options: All bookings — Every booking must fill in the mandatory additional fields. Use this when each booking represents a distinct attendee whose details you need.

All bookings except the first — The first booking is exempt from the additional fields. Use this when the form submitter is also an attendee but the additional fields describe a different person — typically a parent who books for both themselves and their child, where the child's details (date of birth, school, etc.) are collected on the second booking but the parent's are not.

fields.label: If the class reaches full capacity, do not show it in the booking form
Hide from booking form (number of hours) before the programme begins:
fields.help: The programme will not be available for booking the indicated number of hours before the programme begins. The programme will not appear on the booking form.

fields.label: Allow register now, start later
fields.help: A customer can register now but begin on a later date. You set only how far ahead they may start; individual start dates are not managed here.

fields.label: Priority registration
fields.help: Let eligible returning customers register before the class opens to everyone. You set the priority-open moment and, optionally, when it opens to the public. Who is eligible is handled automatically.

cards.title: Communication
intro: The Customize email button opens the template editor. After creating or editing a template there, select it here and save — otherwise this programme keeps sending the current one.

fields.label: Send automatic email reminders the day before the session
fields.help: If checked, session reminders will be sent to the booking at 09.00 the day before.

notes: You’ve disabled late bookings. Therefore clients can enrol to single session only before a class starts
